description: This file defines the ProjectsApiController class, which handles various API endpoints related to projects within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes functionalities such as listing projects, retrieving project details, updating properties, uploading and managing images, handling investments, exporting investment data as CSV, and other project management operations.

classes.name: ProjectsApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for project management, including listing, detail retrieval, property updates, image management, investment operations, and export functionalities.

methods.name: projectsAction
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of projects with filtering options based on query parameters.

methods.name: projectAction
methods.description: Returns detailed information about a specific project identified by id.

methods.name: projectPropertyAction
methods.description: Allows viewing or updating a specific property of a project via GET or PUT requests.

methods.name: projectUpdatesPropertyAction
methods.description: Handles viewing or updating properties of project update posts associated with a project.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates a project for editing permissions and fetches its data.

methods.name: projectUploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles uploading images to a project, with options to add to gallery or set as default.

methods.name: projectDeleteImagesAction
methods.description: Removes an image from a project's gallery.

methods.name: projectDefaultImagesAction
methods.description: Sets an image as the default project image.

methods.name: projectReorderImagesAction
methods.description: Reorders images within a project gallery.

methods.name: projectMaterialsAction
methods.description: Manages materials related to a project, including adding new ones and updating URLs.

methods.name: projectInvestsFulfilledAction
methods.description: Sets the fulfilled status of an investment in a project.

methods.name: projectInvestsCSVAction
methods.description: Exports investments for a project as a CSV file.

methods.name: projectDeleteSupportMsgAction
methods.description: Deletes a support message associated with an investment.

methods.name: projectsFootprintsOrSDGs
methods.description: Provides project data filtered by footprints or SDGs with various views.

methods.name: getListProjectViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares a list view response for projects.

methods.name: getMosaicViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares a mosaic view response for projects.

methods.name: getJsonViewResponse
methods.description: Prepares a JSON response with project summaries for map view.
